program: T-CAIREM V7 AF Density Research Directive

findings.lookahead_leakage_prevention: Target window starts strictly at or after landmark prediction timestamp
findings.verification: Verified via P01-P03 landmark indexing protocol

findings.eligibility_rule: Shorter episodes are censored/excluded from elapsed physiological landmarks

findings.bootstrap_protocol: B=2000 patient-clustered bootstrap for confidence intervals

findings.abstention_policy: Selective prediction: abstention on N2 uninterpretable strips

findings.null_a_repositioning: Brief runs repositioned uniformly in non-AF intervals conditional on prolonged episode locations
findings.null_b_duration_ordering: Episode durations permuted within patient history conditional on gap distribution
findings.burden_preservation: Total AF burden and episode counts exactly preserved under null realizations

findings.evidence_separation: Strictly separates reference rhythm evidence, physiological feature evidence, and clinical correlations
findings.negative_results_governance: Null associations, non-significant predictor contributions, and sensor degradation explicitly reported
findings.noninferiority_policy: No claim of superiority without multiplicity-adjusted statistical significance
